title: Superweapons
text: The great superweapons of the old wars: the GLA's **SCUD Storm**, China's **Nuclear Missile** and the USA's **Particle Uplink Cannon**. Each is a structure of its own and charges for minutes on power; the SCUD Storm and the Nuclear Missile take only their own ammunition (built at a factory of their own faction, the **Arms Dealer** or the **War Factory**), the cannon none. Each is fired from a [Launch Computer](ordnance/launch_site). When one is built, readied or fired, everyone in the dimension hears the warning.
